But different when account is special Vulnerable code snippet: Attack tx: https://etherscan.io/tx/0x7acc896b8d82874c67127ff3359d7437a15fdb4229ed83da00da1f4d8370764e Analysis:

Gain was exploited on Ethereum Mainnet on 2024-02-21 through an infinite-mint style accounting flaw. The linked exploit transaction shows a flash-liquidity driven drain of the GAIN/WETH pair and 6.43293695095562743 ETH routed to the attacker contract, while the catalogue loss figure remains unreconciled. A bad function implementation in GAIN's token and share accounting created an infinite mint path that let the attacker desynchronize the GAIN/WETH pool and extract WETH with reserve-manipulation calls.
